candidates.economic_hypothesis: After removing the contemporaneous equal-weight leave-one-out market component, a stock whose residual price discovery is concentrated positively in the final 60 afternoon return positions may carry firm-specific information from the next open through the third close.
candidates.formula: sum(e_i,t for the final 60 afternoon returns ending 14:01-15:00) / sum(abs(e_i,t) over all 238 within-half returns), where e_i,t=r_i,t-beta_i*m_-i,t, beta_i=sum(r_i,t*m_-i,t)/sum(m_-i,t^2), and m_-i,t is the equal-weight leave-one-out market return
formula_steps: Use only the 240 closes ending 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00; preserve but exclude the standalone 09:30 source row.
Form 119 adjacent log close returns separately inside each half-session, yielding 238 aligned positions; exclude the 11:30-to-13:01 lunch return.

At every trade date and return position, use the frozen equal-weight market sum and valid-stock count, subtract the stock's own return and one valid observation, and divide to obtain the leave-one-out market return.
Require at least 50 other valid stocks at every return position.
Fit one full-day through-origin beta exactly as sum(stock_return * leave_one_out_market_return) divided by sum(leave_one_out_market_return squared); a zero market-energy denominator is missing.
Subtract beta times the leave-one-out market return from each stock return.
Sum residuals only over the final 60 afternoon returns ending 14:01 through 15:00, corresponding to combined return indices 178 through 237 inclusive.
Divide that signed late residual sum by total absolute residual variation over all 238 positions; a zero denominator is missing.
Only a 1e-12 floating-point endpoint canonicalization to the closed interval [-1,1] is allowed.

candidates.economic_hypothesis: A high fraction of amount arriving on negative one-minute moves that are immediately followed by a positive one-minute move may identify intraday selling pressure that is absorbed rather than propagated, with possible persistence over the next three-session holding rule.
candidates.formula: sum(amount_at_destination_of_r_t for within-half adjacent pairs with r_t<0 and r_t+1>0) / sum(amount_at_destination_of_r_t for within-half adjacent pairs with r_t<0)
formula_steps: Use only the 240 closes and amounts ending 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00; preserve but exclude standalone 09:30.
Require every selected close to be finite and strictly positive and every selected amount to be finite and nonnegative.
Form 119 adjacent log close returns separately in each half-session and then 118 adjacent return pairs per half, yielding 236 pairs.
Exclude both the lunch return and the cross-half adjacent return pair.
For each initiating return r_t, assign the amount on r_t's destination bar; do not assign the amount of r_t+1.
The denominator sums that destination amount only where r_t is strictly negative.
The numerator sums the same weights only where r_t is strictly negative and r_t+1 is strictly positive.
Zero returns are neither negative initiators nor positive recoveries; a zero total negative-return amount is missing.
Only a 1e-12 floating-point endpoint canonicalization to the closed interval [0,1] is allowed.

candidates.economic_hypothesis: A high signed displacement relative to total intraday path variation represents directionally efficient price discovery rather than oscillation and may persist from the next open through the third close.
candidates.formula: log(close_15:00/close_09:31) / sum(abs(adjacent log close return)) over the collapsed 240-close path including the 11:30-to-13:01 pair
formula_steps: Use only the 240 closes ending 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00; preserve but exclude standalone 09:30.
Require all 240 closes to be finite and strictly positive.
Collapse the lunch clock gap so 11:30 and 13:01 are adjacent observations and form all 239 adjacent log close returns, including that pair.
Use log(15:00 close divided by 09:31 close) as the signed numerator.
Use the sum of the absolute values of all 239 adjacent log returns as the denominator.
A zero total path variation is missing.
Only a 1e-12 floating-point endpoint canonicalization to the closed interval [-1,1] is allowed.
